skills.name: Unarmed Fighting
skills.description: Strike, grapple, and keep your footing without relying on a named weapon.
skills.entry_hint: Practice in a safe spar or stand your ground when a threat closes in.

skills.name: Sword Fighting
skills.description: Read a blade's reach, balance, and recovery in close combat.
skills.entry_hint: Use a sword in a real encounter and listen to how its weight answers.

skills.name: Axe Fighting
skills.description: Turn a heavy edge into deliberate, committed blows.
skills.entry_hint: Learn the rhythm of an axe from a trainer, weapon, or patient sparring partner.

skills.name: Spear Fighting
skills.description: Control distance and line with a thrusting weapon.
skills.entry_hint: Take up a spear at a training yard or on the road.

skills.name: Bow Fighting
skills.description: Set range, draw cleanly, and release a shot with intent.
skills.entry_hint: Complete a first practice with a bow and a target.

skills.name: Shield Use
skills.description: Protect an ally or opening while keeping a mobile stance.
skills.entry_hint: Hold a shield through a guarded drill or a dangerous approach.

skills.name: Wind Magic
skills.description: Shape moving air for travel, warning, and force.
skills.entry_hint: Attune to a current of air with a teacher, text, or first working.

skills.name: Water Magic
skills.description: Call, guide, and calm water in useful forms.
skills.entry_hint: Find a patient pool, a willing mentor, or a first successful working.

skills.name: Electricity Magic
skills.description: Gather a spark and direct it without losing control.
skills.entry_hint: Study a spark in a storm or complete an introductory attunement.

skills.name: Fire Magic
skills.description: Kindle and contain heat for light, craft, and defence.
skills.entry_hint: Begin with a supervised flame and an obvious safety lesson.

skills.name: Earth Magic
skills.description: Listen to stone and soil, then move only what is needed.
skills.entry_hint: Work beside a stonecutter, geomancer, or living hillside.

skills.name: Restoration Magic
skills.description: Mend a small wound or restore a worn thing without erasing its history.
skills.entry_hint: Learn a careful restorative working from a healer or first success.

skills.name: Foraging
skills.description: Recognise useful plants, safe water, and signs of a living place.
skills.entry_hint: Gather a useful wild resource and ask what the land is offering.

skills.name: Forestry
skills.description: Read trees as habitats and harvest timber without wasting a grove.
skills.entry_hint: Work at the forest edge with an axe, saw, or forester's lesson.

skills.name: Mining
skills.description: Find useful seams and bring stone or ore out safely.
skills.entry_hint: Take a first careful extraction from a marked stone face.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.description: Read water, weather, and patience to bring up a catch.
skills.entry_hint: Make a first catch with a line, net, or local fisher's advice.

skills.name: Hunting
skills.description: Track animals and choose a clean, sustainable approach.
skills.entry_hint: Follow a trail with a guide or make a responsible first hunt.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Make sound decisions when shelter, supplies, and safe routes are uncertain.
skills.entry_hint: Complete a journey or wilderness task with your preparation intact.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.description: Keep a heading through roads, weather, and unfamiliar country.
skills.entry_hint: Lead or complete a journey and compare the route with what you expected.

skills.name: Crop Tending
skills.description: Plant, tend, and harvest crops with attention to quality and timing.
skills.entry_hint: Complete a first action in a shared field plot.

skills.name: Animal Husbandry
skills.description: Keep animals healthy, useful, and part of a sustainable household.
skills.entry_hint: Help with an animal's care under a farmer's guidance.

skills.name: Carpentry
skills.description: Turn prepared timber into sound structures, fittings, tools, and furniture.
skills.entry_hint: Complete an introductory project at a woodworking bench or with a beginner manual.

skills.name: Smithing
skills.description: Shape metal into dependable tools, fittings, and weapons.
skills.entry_hint: Assist at a forge and finish a safe first piece.

skills.name: Tailoring
skills.description: Measure, cut, and join cloth into useful, lasting forms.
skills.entry_hint: Make or mend a first garment with a needle and suitable cloth.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.description: Turn ingredients into meals worth sharing without making food compulsory.
skills.entry_hint: Prepare a first meal at a safe hearth or with a cook's lesson.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.description: Combine gathered materials into deliberate, repeatable compounds.
skills.entry_hint: Complete a supervised first mixture and record what changed.

skills.name: Masonry
skills.description: Set stone so a wall, road, or hearth can endure.
skills.entry_hint: Place or repair a first piece of public or private masonry.

skills.name: General Crafting
skills.description: Make useful things from ordinary materials while learning their limits.
skills.entry_hint: Finish a simple hand-made object and notice which material choices mattered.

skills.name: Trade
skills.description: Read value, negotiate fairly, and move goods where they matter.
skills.entry_hint: Complete a fair exchange and observe what the other person needed.

skills.name: Teaching
skills.description: Help another person understand a practice through demonstration and patience.
skills.entry_hint: Guide a learner through a real task instead of handing over an answer.

skills.name: Leadership
skills.description: Coordinate people and resources toward a shared, accountable outcome.
skills.entry_hint: Take responsibility for a public task and report what the group achieved.

skills.name: Weapon Fighting
skills.description: Switch between melee traditions, carry stance from one weapon to another, and read unfamiliar reach.
skills.entry_hint: Your different melee disciplines resonate. Further varied experience is required before the pattern becomes a usable art.

skills.name: Storm Magic
skills.description: Prepare deliberate storm workings by combining wind, water, and electricity with care.
skills.entry_hint: The three currents answer one another. Severe weather and repeated three-element workings may reveal what comes next.
